findings.title: K1 completed command preview attaches the editor cwd to the actual execution command
findings.trigger: Generate or run a generated K1 project, then read/copy the displayed completed command; the execution snapshot uses its private execution-inputs cwd while live F5 project keeps its editing workspaceRoot.
findings.reason: _bind_experiment_package passes record.command into _format_command_preview, but formatter unconditionally gets working_directory from self.project.workspaceRoot. The binding updates config/macro/output only and intentionally leaves the edit model cwd alone.
findings.impact: The displayed command arguments belong to the observed run but the displayed cwd does not. Manual replay can interpret relative resources/data or later macro commands against the wrong directory. Actual runner cwd was correct in the inspected receipt; this finding does not claim simulation output corruption.

evidence.evidence_level: static call-chain plus existing saved-model and actual launch receipt; hidden preview cwd was not newly observed on screen

findings.existing_test_gap: Run-input-modes preview checks cover editor/external preview values and stale warnings; reviewed checks do not compare the displayed completed K1 cwd to the same record.launch working_directory.
findings.recommendation: Let the formatter take explicit observed logical cwd for completed K1 records (and distinguish launch cwd when relevant), or render the execution project/launch receipt. Keep the editing F5 workspaceRoot unchanged. Preserve current editor-preview behavior before dispatch.
findings.validation: source reasoning and existing native receipt only; no new test or UI operation

findings.title: Known pending workflow states are rendered as Unobserved
findings.trigger: A normal operation is pending, or a previously passed evidence level is undergoing asynchronous freshness checking.
findings.reason: Workflow._state explicitly returns pending for level/overall statuses; the desktop adapter passes those strings through. STATUS_TEXT has no pending, so _status_text replaces it with unobserved. Summary and level labels therefore discard a valid in-progress state.
findings.impact: A display-only information loss: a real check in progress is indistinguishable from an unobserved result. This is conservative and does not confer passed status, alter cancellation, or corrupt qualification.

evidence.native_image_observation: Header and telemetry show running, event level shows 未观测; image alone is not used to establish the exact pending payload.

findings.existing_test_gap: smoke_k1_panel enumerates STATUS_TEXT itself and tests future unknown values; it never supplies the real producer pending status. History-scope components test RunPage checking but do not assert ExperimentPanel pending labels.
findings.recommendation: Map the real pending state to an explicit translated in-progress/checking label while preserving unknown-value fallback. Add explicit producer-value assertions in both languages, rather than testing only keys already present in the consumer dictionary.
findings.validation: static producer/adapter/consumer contract read plus existing snapshot and image; no new test run
